passages.title: 便利商店的新店員
passages.text: There is a convenience store across the street from our school. Because it is so {1}, students go there every day after class. Last week, a new clerk started working there. He was an old man with white hair, and he was very {2}. He always said hello to us with a big smile. One day, I saw him write a {3} of our names in a small notebook. "I want to remember every student," he said. Now he knows that I like green tea and my best friend likes chocolate milk. On rainy days, he puts a {4} on the door: "Free umbrellas for students. Please bring them back." Thanks to him, the store isn't just a place to buy snacks. It is a place that {5} our hearts with warmth.

blanks.why: it is so convenient「它非常方便」，所以學生每天都去。hungry（餓的）、honest（誠實的）、afraid（害怕的）都不能用來形容商店。
very friendly「非常友善」，後面說他總是笑著跟我們打招呼。national（國家的）、expensive（昂貴的）、empty（空的）都不能形容老先生的個性。
a list of our names「一份我們名字的清單」。noise（噪音）、smoke（煙）、joy（喜悅）都不能寫在筆記本上列出名字。
puts a sign on the door「在門上貼一個告示」，冒號後面就是告示的內容。smell（氣味）、taste（味道）、grade（成績）都不能貼在門上。
fill A with B「用 B 裝滿 A」，fills our hearts with warmth「讓我們心裡充滿溫暖」。主詞 that 指 a place，所以用 fills。lend、borrow 不能和 with warmth 搭配；seem 後面要接形容詞。

passages.zh: 我們學校對面有一家便利商店。因為它非常方便，學生每天下課後都會去。上星期，有一位新店員開始在那裡工作。他是一位白頭髮的老先生，非常友善，總是笑容滿面地跟我們打招呼。有一天，我看到他在一本小筆記本上寫下一份我們名字的清單。「我想記住每一個學生。」他說。現在他知道我喜歡喝綠茶，我最好的朋友喜歡喝巧克力牛奶。下雨天時，他會在門上貼一張告示：「學生可免費借傘，請記得歸還。」因為有他，這家店不只是買零食的地方，更是一個讓我們心裡充滿溫暖的地方。

passages.title: 抄作業被抓到
passages.text: Kevin forgot to do his math homework, so he {1} his classmate's answers before class. He thought it was a smart idea. But when Ms. Lin checked the homework, she found something strange. Both notebooks had the {2} mistake in question five: "3 + 5 = 9." She called both boys to her office. "Who copied?" she asked. Kevin's face turned red, and he told the truth. Ms. Lin didn't shout. Instead, she said, "Copying is easy, but it can't help you learn. Your friends' habits can {3} you, and you can influence them, too." Then she gave Kevin a {4} of extra math questions to do at home. That weekend, Kevin did every question by himself. On Monday, he went {5} to Ms. Lin's desk and showed her his work. "All correct," she said with a smile. Kevin felt proud. He never copied again.

blanks.why: copied his classmate's answers「抄同學的答案」。arrive、seem、die 都不能直接接受詞 answers。
the same mistake「同樣的錯誤」，兩本作業錯在同一個地方，老師才發現有人抄。whole（整個的）不能形容一個錯誤；alone、afraid 不能放在名詞前面。
influence you「影響你」，後面也說 you can influence them。arrive、happen、seem 都不能直接接受詞 you。
a list of extra math questions「一張額外的數學題目清單」。sight（景象）、sign（標誌）、smoke（煙）都不能表示一份題目。
went straight to「直接走到…」。ago 要放在時間後面；quite（相當）要修飾形容詞或副詞；such 後面要接名詞。

passages.zh: 凱文忘了寫數學作業，所以上課前抄了同學的答案。他以為這是個聰明的辦法。但林老師改作業時發現了一件奇怪的事：兩本作業在第五題都有同樣的錯誤——「3 + 5 = 9」。她把兩個男生叫到辦公室。「是誰抄的？」她問。凱文的臉紅了，說出了實話。林老師沒有大罵，而是說：「抄作業很容易，但它沒辦法幫你學會。朋友的習慣會影響你，你也能影響他們。」接著她給了凱文一張額外的數學題目清單，讓他回家做。那個週末，凱文每一題都自己做。星期一，他直接走到林老師的桌前，把作業拿給她看。「全部正確。」她笑著說。凱文覺得很驕傲，從此再也沒有抄過作業。

passages.title: 第一次看到海豚
passages.text: Last summer, my family took a boat trip in Hualien to look for dolphins. The sea was calm, and the sky was clear. After an hour, we still hadn't seen anything, and my little brother was bored. Then the captain shouted, "Look! On the left!" It was an amazing {1}: about twenty dolphins were jumping out of the water. Some swam {2} toward our boat. Everyone ran to the side of the boat with their phones. The captain said dolphins are very {3} animals and like to play near boats. "But please don't throw food into the sea," he said. "Human food can make them sick." My brother's eyes were {4} with joy. On the way back, he made a {5} of all the sea animals he wanted to see next time: whales, sea turtles, and flying fish.

blanks.why: an amazing sight「一個令人驚嘆的景象」，冒號後面就是看到的畫面。habit（習慣）、topic（主題）、grade（成績）都不能表示眼前看到的畫面。
swam straight toward our boat「直直地朝我們的船游過來」。ago 要放在時間後面；quite 要修飾形容詞或副詞；such 後面要接名詞。
friendly animals「友善的動物」，喜歡在船邊玩。empty（空的）、expensive（昂貴的）、national（國家的）都不能形容海豚的個性。
be filled with joy「充滿喜悅」。lent、borrowed 不能和 with joy 搭配；seemed 不能放在 were 後面。
made a list of「列了一張…的清單」，冒號後面列出想看的動物。sight、smoke、noise 都不能「列出」動物。

passages.zh: 去年夏天，我們全家在花蓮搭船出海找海豚。海面很平靜，天空很晴朗。過了一個小時，我們什麼都還沒看到，我弟弟覺得好無聊。這時船長大喊：「看！左邊！」那是一幅令人驚嘆的景象：大約二十隻海豚正躍出水面，有些還直直地朝我們的船游過來。大家都拿著手機跑到船邊。船長說海豚是很友善的動物，喜歡在船的附近玩。「不過請不要把食物丟進海裡，」他說，「人類的食物會讓牠們生病。」我弟弟的眼裡充滿了喜悅。回程時，他列了一張下次想看的海洋動物清單：鯨魚、海龜和飛魚。

passages.title: 不是有錢就快樂
passages.text: Mr. Chen was so {1} that he owned three cars, two houses, and a boat. But he never smiled. His neighbors said he was not {2} at all; he never said hello to anyone. One day, his car broke down near a small noodle shop. It was raining hard, and his phone had no power. The owner of the shop, an old woman, invited him in and gave him a bowl of hot noodles. She didn't know who he was. "You look cold. Eat first," she said. It was the best meal he had had in years. When he tried to pay, she pointed to a {3} on the wall: "Free noodles on rainy days." "Just smile more," she said. That night, Mr. Chen made a {4} of his neighbors' names. Over the next month, he visited each of them with a small gift. Slowly, his life was {5} with friends.

blanks.why: so rich that he owned three cars…「有錢到擁有三輛車…」。wet（濕的）、sharp（尖銳的）、empty（空的）都不能說明為什麼他有那麼多車和房子。
not friendly at all「一點也不友善」，後面說他從不跟人打招呼。modern（現代的）、national（國家的）、expensive（昂貴的）都不能形容人的態度。
a sign on the wall「牆上的一張告示」，冒號後面是告示的內容。sight（景象）、smoke（煙）、noise（噪音）都不能貼在牆上、寫著字。
made a list of his neighbors' names「把鄰居的名字列成一張清單」。sight、joy、smoke 都不能用來列名字。
be filled with friends「充滿朋友」。lent、borrowed 不能和 with friends 搭配；smelled 用在這裡意思不通。

passages.zh: 陳先生有錢到擁有三輛車、兩棟房子和一艘船，但他從來不笑。鄰居們說他一點也不友善，從不跟任何人打招呼。有一天，他的車在一家小麵店附近拋錨了。雨下得很大，他的手機也沒電了。麵店老闆是一位老婆婆，她請他進來，還給了他一碗熱騰騰的麵。她不知道他是誰。「你看起來很冷，先吃吧。」她說。那是他好幾年來吃過最好吃的一餐。他想付錢時，她指著牆上的一張告示：「下雨天麵免費。」「多笑一點就好。」她說。那天晚上，陳先生把鄰居的名字列成一張清單。接下來的一個月，他帶著小禮物一一拜訪他們。慢慢地，他的生活充滿了朋友。

passages.title: 簽名球
passages.text: My favorite baseball player is Chang Wei of the Taipei Tigers. Last Saturday, I went to the stadium with my dad. After the game, some players came out to {1} balls for fans. The line was very long, but I didn't want to {2}. I waited for two hours. When it was finally my turn, Chang Wei looked at my old glove and asked, "Do you play baseball, too?" I told him I was on my school team, but I often missed the ball. He was very {3} and gave me some advice: "Keep your eyes on the ball and your back {4}." Then he wrote a short message on my ball: "Never give up!" His words had a big {5} on me. Now I practice every day after school, and last week I hit my first home run.

blanks.why: sign balls「在球上簽名」。copy（抄寫）、fill（裝滿）、list（列出）接 balls 都說不通。
didn't want to leave「不想離開」，所以等了兩個小時。copy、fill、lend 後面都要接受詞，而且意思不通。
very friendly「很友善」，還主動關心我、給我建議。empty（空的）、wooden（木製的）、national（國家的）都不能形容人。
keep your back straight「保持背部挺直」，keep + 受詞 + 形容詞。ago、seldom 是副詞，such 要接名詞，都不能放在這裡。
have an influence on「對…有影響」。noise、smoke、joy 都不能和 have a big ___ on me 搭配。

passages.zh: 我最喜歡的棒球選手是台北老虎隊的張威。上星期六，我和爸爸去球場看球。比賽結束後，有些球員出來幫球迷在球上簽名。隊伍排得很長，但我不想離開，等了兩個小時。終於輪到我時，張威看著我那個舊手套問：「你也打棒球嗎？」我說我是校隊的，但常常接不到球。他非常友善，給了我一些建議：「眼睛盯著球，背要挺直。」接著他在我的球上寫了一句話：「永不放棄！」他的話對我影響很大。現在我每天放學後都練習，上星期還打出了我的第一支全壘打。

passages.title: 帶外國遊客去龍山寺
passages.text: On my way home, I saw a foreign woman looking at her map with a worried face. I wanted to help, but I was shy. Then I remembered my English teacher's words: "Be brave and {1}." So I walked over and said, "Can I help you?" She smiled and said she wanted to go to Longshan Temple. "Go {2} for two blocks, then turn left," I said. Then I decided it would be easier to take her there myself. On the way, she asked me about every {3} on the street. "What does that one say?" I explained that the Chinese words meant "Night Market" and "Bubble Tea." She took a picture of each one. When we arrived at the temple, she said, "Taipei is so {4}. There's a convenience store on every corner!" Before she left, she wrote down a {5} of places I recommended: Jiufen, Taipei 101, and Tamsui. My English wasn't perfect, but it was good enough.

blanks.why: be brave and friendly「勇敢又友善」，所以我主動上前幫忙。empty（空的）、wooden（木製的）、national（國家的）都不能形容人的態度。
go straight「直走」，報路時最常用的說法。ago 要放在時間後面；quite 要修飾形容詞或副詞；such 後面要接名詞。
every sign on the street「街上的每個招牌」，後面問「那個寫什麼？」。joy、grade、habit 都不是街上看得到、上面有字的東西。
so convenient「很方便」，因為每個街角都有便利商店。hungry、honest、afraid 都不能形容城市。
a list of places「一張地點清單」，冒號後面列出地名。sight、smoke、noise 都不能「寫下」地點。

passages.zh: 回家路上，我看到一位外國女士拿著地圖，一臉擔心。我想幫忙，但我很害羞。這時我想起英文老師說的話：「要勇敢又友善。」於是我走過去說：「需要幫忙嗎？」她笑著說她想去龍山寺。「直走兩個街區，然後左轉。」我說。接著我覺得乾脆直接帶她去比較簡單。路上，她問我街上每個招牌是什麼。「那個寫什麼？」我解釋那些中文字是「夜市」和「珍珠奶茶」。她把每一個都拍了下來。到了龍山寺，她說：「台北好方便，每個街角都有便利商店！」離開前，她寫下我推薦的地點清單：九份、台北101和淡水。我的英文不完美，但已經夠用了。

passages.title: 奶奶的手寫食譜
passages.text: Grandma is a wonderful cook, but she never measures anything. "A little salt, a little sugar," she always says. When she turned eighty, I decided to {1} her recipes into a notebook before they were lost. First, I made a {2} of the dishes she cooks most often. Then, every Sunday, I watched her cook and wrote down every step. "How much is 'a little'?" I asked. She laughed and showed me with her hand. Her braised pork was the hardest. She cut the meat, {3} the pot with soy sauce and water, and cooked it for two hours. The smell made everyone in the house hungry. After three months, my notebook was full. I gave a {4} to each of my aunts. Grandma's cooking has {5} me a lot. Now I want to be a cook, too.

blanks.why: copy her recipes into a notebook「把她的食譜抄到筆記本上」。arrive、happen、seem 都不能直接接受詞。
made a list of the dishes「把菜色列成一張清單」。sight（景象）、noise（噪音）、smoke（煙）都不能用來列菜名。
filled the pot with soy sauce and water「在鍋裡裝滿醬油和水」，和 cut、cooked 一樣用過去式。lent、borrowed 不能和 with 搭配；seemed 後面不能接受詞。
gave a copy to「給…一份（副本）」，copy 在這裡是名詞。sight、noise、smell 都不能拿來「送給」阿姨。
has influenced me「影響了我」，所以我也想當廚師。arrived、happened、seemed 都不能直接接受詞 me。

passages.zh: 奶奶很會做菜，但她從不測量份量。「一點鹽、一點糖。」她總是這麼說。她八十歲那年，我決定在她的食譜失傳之前，把它們抄到筆記本上。首先，我把她最常做的菜列成一張清單。接著每個星期天，我都看她做菜，寫下每一個步驟。「『一點』是多少？」我問。她笑了，用手比給我看。最難的是她的滷肉：她把肉切好，在鍋裡裝滿醬油和水，煮了兩個小時。那香味讓家裡每個人都餓了。三個月後，我的筆記本寫滿了。我給每位阿姨各一份。奶奶的廚藝對我影響很大，現在我也想當廚師。

passages.title: 漫畫社的招生海報
passages.text: Our school's comic club needed new members, so my friends and I decided to make a poster. Mia drew a big cartoon cat in the middle, and she {1} the background with colorful stars. Under the cat, I wrote: "Want to join? Please {2} your name below." We hung it next to the school gate. On the first day, only two people signed. "Maybe our poster isn't interesting enough," Mia said. So we added a speech bubble to the cat: "I'm {3}. Please be my friend!" The next day, the {4} of names was much longer. By Friday, we had thirty new members. Our teacher laughed and said, "Good design can {5} people." She was right. Now our club is one of the most popular clubs at school, and that cat became our mascot.

blanks.why: filled the background with colorful stars「用彩色星星填滿背景」。lent、borrowed 不能和 with 搭配；seemed 後面不能接受詞。
sign your name「簽上你的名字」。arrive、seem 不能接受詞；cheer your name（為你的名字歡呼）說不通。
I'm lonely.「我好孤單」，所以「請當我的朋友」。wooden（木製的）、convenient（方便的）、national（國家的）都不能接「請當我的朋友」。
the list of names「簽名的名單」變長了。sight、smoke、noise 都不能表示一串名字。
influence people「影響人們」，好設計讓更多人加入。arrive、happen、seem 都不能直接接受詞。

passages.zh: 我們學校的漫畫社需要新社員，所以我和朋友決定做一張海報。米亞在中間畫了一隻大大的卡通貓，還用彩色的星星把背景填滿。我在貓的下面寫：「想加入嗎？請在下面簽上你的名字。」我們把海報掛在校門旁邊。第一天只有兩個人簽名。「也許我們的海報不夠有趣。」米亞說。於是我們幫貓加了一個對話框：「我好孤單，請當我的朋友！」隔天，名單變長了好多。到了星期五，我們有了三十個新社員。老師笑著說：「好的設計能影響人。」她說得對。現在我們社團是學校最受歡迎的社團之一，那隻貓也成了我們的吉祥物。

passages.title: 會說真話的鏡子
passages.text: In a small village, there was a magic mirror that could only tell the truth. A king heard about it. He was very {1} and had a hundred rooms full of gold, but he wanted the mirror, too. So he paid the villagers a lot of money and took it to his castle. Every morning, he asked it, "Am I the greatest king in the world?" The mirror always answered, "No. You have gold, but your people are hungry." The king was angry. He {2} his room with other mirrors, but none of them could talk. One day, he walked through the city for the first time. The {3} of poor children in the streets made him sad. He went {4} back to the castle and wrote a {5} of things to fix: schools, roads, and hospitals. Then he opened his gold rooms to his people. The next morning, he asked again. The mirror smiled. "Now you are a great king."

blanks.why: very rich「非常有錢」，有一百個裝滿黃金的房間。empty（空的）、wooden（木製的）、convenient（方便的）都不能形容國王。
filled his room with other mirrors「在房間裡擺滿其他鏡子」。lent、borrowed 不能和 with 搭配；seemed 後面不能接受詞。
the sight of poor children「看到貧窮孩子的景象」讓他難過。habit（習慣）、topic（主題）、grade（成績）都說不通。
went straight back「直接回去」。ago 要放在時間後面；quite 要修飾形容詞或副詞；such 後面要接名詞。
a list of things to fix「一張要改善的事情清單」，冒號後面列出項目。sight、smoke、noise 都不能「寫」出來列項目。

passages.zh: 在一個小村莊裡，有一面只會說真話的魔鏡。有一位國王聽說了這件事。他非常有錢，有一百個裝滿黃金的房間，但他還想要那面鏡子。於是他付給村民很多錢，把鏡子帶回城堡。每天早上，他都問鏡子：「我是世界上最偉大的國王嗎？」鏡子總是回答：「不是。你有黃金，但你的人民在挨餓。」國王很生氣，他在房間裡擺滿了其他鏡子，但沒有一面會說話。有一天，他第一次走過城裡。看到街上貧窮孩子的景象，他很難過。他直接回到城堡，寫下一張要改善的事情清單：學校、道路和醫院。接著他把黃金房間開放給人民。隔天早上，他又問了一次。鏡子笑了：「現在你是一位偉大的國王了。」

passages.title: 如果我有任意門
passages.text: If I could have one of Doraemon's tools, I would choose the Anywhere Door. It is the most {1} tool of all. I wouldn't need to wake up early or take the bus to school. I could just open the door and walk {2} into my classroom. I already have a {3} of places I want to visit. First, I would go to Japan to eat real ramen. Then, I would visit Paris to see the Eiffel Tower. It must be a beautiful {4} at night. But my mom says it would be dangerous. "Doraemon's tools always cause trouble for Nobita," she said. "What if someone {5} your door and walked into our house at night?" Maybe she's right. But I would still like to try it, just once.

blanks.why: the most convenient tool「最方便的道具」，不用早起搭車。hungry（餓的）、honest（誠實的）、afraid（害怕的）都不能形容道具。
walk straight into my classroom「直接走進教室」。ago 要放在時間後面；quite 要修飾形容詞或副詞；ever 不能放在動詞 walk 後面表示方向。
a list of places「一張想去的地點清單」。sight、smoke、noise 都不能表示一串地點。
a beautiful sight「美麗的景象」，指夜晚的艾菲爾鐵塔。habit（習慣）、grade（成績）、topic（主題）都不能形容一座鐵塔。
copied your door「複製了你的門」。arrived、seemed、happened 都不能直接接受詞 your door。

passages.zh: 如果我能擁有一個哆啦A夢的道具，我會選任意門。它是所有道具裡最方便的。我不用早起，也不用搭公車上學，只要打開門，就能直接走進教室。我已經列好一張想去的地點清單。首先，我要去日本吃道地的拉麵；接著，我要去巴黎看艾菲爾鐵塔，它在晚上一定是很美的景象。但我媽媽說那樣很危險。「哆啦A夢的道具總是給大雄惹麻煩，」她說，「萬一有人複製了你的門，半夜走進我們家怎麼辦？」也許她說得對，但我還是想試試看，就一次也好。
